title: pesto M0 Implementation Plan
summary: Task-by-task M0 build plan for a local PEST++/MODFLOW 6 viewer: ingest cache, HTTP query API, and WebGL2 map rendering.
notes: Lives under */plans/*, no directory convention match; date prefix is not an ADR sequence. No frontmatter, no Decision/Consequences, no user stories. Content is dominated by implementation contracts: file structure, cache format version rules, HTTP endpoint surface, GPU buffer layouts, and measured performance budgets with acceptance checks, plus a 'Global Constraints' section of binding technical rules. SPEC vs DOC competed; ambiguity rule selects the higher-precedence type (SPEC) because the binding constraints and acceptance criteria would be lost if treated as context-only. Derived from a separate visual-design spec, which it references.
